svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 01 · Santa Barbara · 11/12 The Santa Ynez (Common)
svg.desc: The mountains behind everything. They turn pink for about four minutes at dusk. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
